name: Mahanaim
line: Mahanaim was a city east of the Jordan River, named by Jacob after he saw God's camp, and later a royal base for Ish-bosheth and David.

moments.title: Jacob Names Mahanaim
moments.text: As Jacob traveled, the angels of God met him. He said, "This is the camp of God," and named the place Mahanaim.

moments.title: Ish-bosheth Made King
moments.text: Abner, the commander of Saul's army, moved Saul's son Ish-bosheth to Mahanaim. There he made him king over Israel, while Judah followed David.

moments.title: David Finds Help
moments.text: David came to Mahanaim, where Shobi, Machir, and Barzillai met him. They brought beds, food, and supplies for his hungry and tired people.

moments.title: Barzillai Provides for the King
moments.text: Barzillai, a very wealthy man of eighty, had provided for David while he stayed in Mahanaim. David asked him to come to Jerusalem, but Barzillai asked to go home, so David kissed him and blessed him.
